feature: POSIX controls in valid UTF-8 path components and symlink targets

behavior.path_components_and_symlink_targets: accept all well-formed UTF-8 scalars except U+0000, without normalization
behavior.unchanged_limits: 255 bytes per component and 4096 bytes per path or symlink target
behavior.unchanged_rejections: malformed UTF-8, NUL, slash/dot/dotdot component rules, and paths, targets or components exceeding their byte limits
behavior.strict_metadata_names: volume labels and extended-attribute names still reject C0, DEL, and C1 controls
behavior.json: directory listing and diff JSON escape every C0 byte; decoded strings preserve the original UTF-8 bytes
behavior.fs_ls: raw line-delimited output remains ambiguous for names containing newline; use JSON session directory pages
behavior.repository_format: unchanged raw byte keys; no version bump or record ambiguity
